checks.message: Package inventory, hashes, bilingual pairs, sections, and participant path rules pass deterministic validation.
Provisional rough boundary is explicitly disclosed and is permitted for content review; all spatial values require recalculation when official polygons arrive.
All three required key areas are present as provisional constraints with no statutory or engineering claim.
Spatial review passes topology and boundary containment checks.
Static bilingual HTML passes required-section, numeric-consistency, and remote-content safety checks.
Professional standards, design-depth items, geometry, metrics, sources, and assumptions are traceable across the package.
Four PDFs contain 22 rendered pages in total, use A3/A0 page sizes, contain no JavaScript, and passed page-by-page visual inspection.
